scope: Independent local-file synthetic inference probe; no APK/default changes; no UI or purchase tools.

research_audit.evidence_boundary: Public source/metadata audit plus host-only probe build. No weights downloaded, phone contact, APK/default changes, or app operations in this audit.

selection.incumbent: Research alone does not justify replacing the current LFM3-1.7B NPU profile. Incumbent status is not evidence that all app tasks pass.
selection.small_moe_candidate: Compare the existing 8B MoE compact-grammar path with the incumbent on identical Chinese tool tasks and actual prompt token counts before changing the default.
selection.large_moe_priority: MobiInfer MiniCPM-V 4.7 35B-A3B mixed-Q3 with external tiled experts is the most concrete next independent large-MoE experiment identified here, because public Android source and Snapdragon 8 Elite measurements exist. It is not yet a Hepta-compatible or device-qualified runtime.
selection.resident_24b: The pinned GenieX probe answers release-runtime identity, explicit batch configuration, and conservative memory admission. It does not provide expert streaming; its 24B Q2_K_L admission requires about 13.38 GiB MemAvailable and may reject a 16GB-class phone with other apps present.
selection.papers: Use EStream for prefill research and BigMoMo for decode/offload design evidence; neither paper's reported results establish availability or performance of a Hepta deployment.

geniex.existing_quant_paths: Q2_K/Q4_K/Q8_0 and MUL_MAT_ID exist, subject to types/layout/shapes/VTCM; an accepted backend name is not whole-graph placement proof.

hardware.verified_in_source: JNI selects two HTP sessions for SM8750 when driver enumeration is unavailable; v79 is outside the low-VMEM branch. Runtime explicitly requires detected HTP devices and uses layer split for two sessions.
cautions: The benchmark shell script fixes ARCH=81 and DEVICES=1; it is not a ready-made razr/v79 command.
Source retains pre-32144 mmap and mapped_clones implementation; a 2026-11-10 backend sync is not the 2026-11-13 IOVA fix.

published_measurements.scope: Author-reported README measurements, not reproduced here. Prompt counts/configurations differ; compare within a matched experiment only.
published_measurements.limits: The foreground-app result belongs to Gen 5. It does not prove virtual-display app automation or touch/focus isolation. A current roughly 5K-token agent prompt would exceed the 4096 source default; truncation or simple linear extrapolation is not acceptance.

limitations: Budget is an estimate, not an allocator limit.
The Kotlin maximum derives from total RAM less a reserve, not current MemAvailable.
The old HEXAGON_RUNTIME.md 5.2–8.0GB/ctx2048 table is stale relative to the release source.
The header says draft3 has not been remeasured against its old calibration.
RSS alone omits some HTP/DMA allocations; monitor global MemAvailable plus PSS/RSS and DMA accounting, while explaining possible double counting.

streaming.implementation: External expert slot bank, phase reuse, lookahead, resident IO workers, and runtime O_DIRECT aligned-read probe are implemented. O_DIRECT failure falls back to buffered IO and must be reported.
streaming.packaging: Resident GGUF + 40 expert layer files + manifest + Q8_0 DSpark + F16 padded projector are a coordinated bundle. Storage bytes are not resident RAM.
streaming.lfm24_q2_limit: The current Python packer rejects Q2_K despite backend Q2_K repack support; the pinned LFM2.5-24B QAD Q2_K_L is not a ready-made streaming bundle.
streaming.runtime_integrity_limit: The native expert manifest parser checks schema/layout/type/shape/file extents, but does not itself enforce conversion.json backend SHA or every file SHA. Hepta admission must pin and verify the coordinated asset set.

asset_metadata.publisher_declared_license: Apache-2.0 in both upstream and derivative cards; full separate LICENSE URL returned 404.
asset_metadata.compatibility_not_yet_proven: Derivative card names an earlier llama.cpp-omni branch. Format name alone does not prove byte/ABI equivalence to the newer MobiInfer release build.

tool_protocol.source_support: Core common sampler includes grammar-constrained sampling; speculative verification calls common_sampler_sample_and_accept_n, which samples and advances grammar one accepted token at a time.
tool_protocol.adapter_gap: MiniCPM47Runtime public API exposes text/vision/history/cancel/reset. Its submit path omits inputs.tools and fails to copy formatted grammar into task sampling. Dense JNI tool support is not MoE adapter support.
tool_protocol.existing_parser: oaicompat_chat_params_parse in server-common.cpp already maps tools/schema, chat grammar, triggers, preserved tokens, generation prompt, stops and parser. It needs Jinja for tools and rejects custom grammar combined with tools.
tool_protocol.modes: Choose one explicit protocol: Hepta action JSON with schema/GBNF and ordinary messages, or native chat tools with the template-generated tool grammar. Do not silently combine incompatible constraint modes.

minimum_port.status: Proposed integration contract, not an existing GenieX or MobiInfer C API.
minimum_port.build: Pin the complete fork; build paired llama/ggml/common/Hexagon host and v79 DSP code, the server queue/context/common/chat/task core and required speculative dependencies. Android CMake already links this core without an HTTP listener. Keep code/ABI separate from GenieX.
minimum_port.worker: Headless dedicated worker process with bounded IPC, current-memory admission, bounded output, deadline/cancel/kill/reap, and serialized NPU ownership. Do not import the demo Activity, download manager, image-generation UI or network listener.
request_contract: Open with verified asset descriptors/paths and explicit context, batch, ubatch, expert-bank/window/prefetch/draft choices.
Submit bounded messages plus exactly one constraint mode and a token/deadline budget.
Stream tokens and structured stop/error/performance events; report actual backend, parameters, draft enabled state, expert IO and memory observations.
Cancel, reset and close with observed process cleanup; retain the existing Hepta semantic action validator and virtual-display tool executor.
minimum_port.initial_trial: Text only, context2048, batch128/ubatch128, original top-8 routing, no hidden expert pruning, conservative measured budget and 128 prompt/64 output tokens. Establish DSpark-off identity first, then compare DSpark3 at the same budget; verify bank capacity against worst-case expert unions. Larger actual agent prompts require an explicit later context/budget trial.
minimum_port.next_gate: Only add image input after text correctness/cleanup and package compatibility pass. Only connect tools after constrained output/semantic tests pass. No production default change based on throughput alone.

licenses.weights: Publisher-declared Apache-2.0; preserve notices and the exact model provenance

estream.retrieval: Official arXiv abs/html fetched with HTTP200; public metadata/text only.
estream.hardware: OnePlus 15 PLK110, Android16, 15.1GiB RAM, Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen5 SM8850, Hexagon v81, UFS4.1.
estream.scope: Prefill-only services; 7B–16B primary comparison, 256–4096 input tokens; scale-up includes 46.7B. Weight-only Q4 with floating activations.
estream.result_scope: Authors report 2.25–27.57x pure-prefill TTFT speedups and 1.19–12.29x lower peak physical memory against the fastest supported baseline per setting. These are not autoregressive decode or Hepta agent measurements.
estream.decision: Useful bounded-arena/group-streaming design. Section7 explicitly leaves decode-specific caching/prediction/speculation to future work.

bigmomo.version: v2, 2026-10-03; v1 search snippets describing up to30B are stale for v2.
bigmomo.scope: Custom llama.cpp/Hexagon runtime; Q4_0 targets with speculative drafts. Main experiments use four MoEs and five workloads; results average10 runs.
bigmomo.scale_80b: Section5.6 really includes Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B on the Gen5 platform. It is not evidence for 80B on a 16GB 8 Elite razr.
bigmomo.reporting_caveat: Abstract says mean1.82x versus best baseline; section5.2/Conclusion say mean1.76x, while1.82x is the maximum cross-device comparison. Prefer the scoped body values.
bigmomo.decision: Supports large-MoE feasibility through movement scheduling and speculative windows; not a drop-in SDK or device qualification.

default_switch_device_gate: Pin APK, runtime, model SHA, actual backend and prompt/grammar/template. Separate model-size effects from compact-grammar effects with a matched 2x2 comparison where both grammars are supported.

Use at least30 matched Chinese cases spanning Notes, shopping browse/cart pre-commit, flight lookup and recovery; critical semantic cases must all pass, including correct tool, arguments, amounts/dates, postconditions and no fabricated completion.

Measure cold/warm load, prompt tokens, prefill, TTFT, decode, complete valid-action latency, end-to-end task time and p50/p95. All trials must fit the configured request/task deadlines; compare identical work.

All app tests stay on the owned virtual display. Observe display/task ownership before and after every operation; no agent input/focus/reparent on display0 even when the same app already has a main-screen task.
Demonstrate zero external-model calls; app internet traffic may remain necessary for live inventory/flights and must not be confused with external inference.

Run three paired repetitions plus a bounded sustained session to detect thermal drift, HTP/IOVA errors, LMK/OOM, memory-reserve breaches and foreground responsiveness regressions; include PSS/RSS/global memory and DMA-aware evidence.
Cancellation/timeout/model switch/reload must release native workers and NPU resources. Repeat after an injected bad output/context overflow and verify no stale tool execution.

Change default only if candidate preserves all critical correctness/isolation gates, improves or matches aggregate task success, and stays within the incumbent deadline/memory/thermal envelope. Grammar validity alone is insufficient.
